title: LibKa0s: Chart widget rendering and hover
cluster_summary: All three findings sit in LibKa0s/WidgetsLineChart.lua's render and hover seam, and none is a live player-visible defect except a cosmetic stale crosshair after a resize. The fix lives in LibKa0s, as one chart-minor bump (CHART_MINOR 2->3): Render re-arms the hover so the resize and data-change staleness clears inside the widget (LK-R-03), and, riding the same bump, the dash/segment emitter clips to the plot rectangle so the region count is bounded by geometry (LK-R-01, latent hardening). The pane-resize double render (LK-R-04) is structurally confirmed but cheap and resize-only. Its optional fix is host-side in LootHistory, and it needs no library seam.

verdicts.assessment: Confirmed in code: Math.Dashes (:205) is uncapped, and dashed() (:253) pools one session-lifetime Line per dash, with no clip to the plot rect. It cannot be reached today, because LootHistory, the only host, derives its x/y domain from its own series. So this is latent library-contract hardening, not a medium defect.
verdicts.remediation: Make the change only in the same chart-minor bump as LK-R-03. Clip each segment to the plot rectangle in one place, in the segment/dash emitter (Liang-Barsky), before dashing, so the dash count is bounded by plot geometry. Off-plot solid segments get clipped too. Bump CHART_MINOR 2->3 and add out-of-domain tests, one dashed and one solid. Do not clamp input or redesign marker handling. If no chart bump ships, file it as a low triaged issue instead.

verdicts.assessment: SetData/Render (:409-410) leave __hoverIndex and the crosshair alone, and HoverAtPixel (:430) re-fires only when the index changes. Pane resize runs TL:Layout -> chart:Render without ClearHover, so even the current host shows a stale crosshair pixel under a resting cursor. The defect is cosmetic, the fix is about two lines, and it removes a trap for every future host.
verdicts.remediation: In WidgetsLineChart.lua, have render() (reached from SetData/Render/OnSizeChanged) reset __hoverIndex to nil so the armed OnUpdate re-evaluates the hover against the new scale and data on the next frame. Ship it in the CHART_MINOR 3 bump with LK-R-01. Add a headless test: hover, Render at a new size, then assert the crosshair and onHover re-fire. LootHistory's explicit ClearHover can stay, since it is idempotent. Update the API doc's 'host must call ClearHover' note to say this is no longer required. The only change in addons is the re-vendor.

verdicts.assessment: This is not unverified. Pane OnSizeChanged runs TL:Layout, which calls chart:Render explicitly (Timeline.lua:332). The anchored chart's own OnSizeChanged (WidgetsLineChart.lua:463) also renders, so every pane resize renders twice. The cost is bounded: pooled regions, one extra LTTB pass and repaint, resize only. Nothing justifies a library seam such as opts.manualRender.
verdicts.remediation: Do not change LibKa0s. If addressed at all, do it host-side in LootHistory: in TL:Layout, skip the explicit chart:Render when the chart's size changed (its own OnSizeChanged already renders), or render explicitly only after SetData. Otherwise leave it until a headless Render-count measurement or a perf capture shows it matters.
